title: Radio: PW-14 at River Road, Then Tallis 911

lines.text: Public Works, PW-14. I'm on River Road, just south of Mill Street. River's into the low end of Riverside Park, and it's maybe two feet below the road shoulder down by the boat ramp. Still coming up.

Barricade trailer's got twelve Type Three barricades on it. That covers River Road, but it won't cover the Mill Street underpass too. I called Prairie Barricade Rental. Their extra stock's out on a highway job until Thursday. How do you want me to split what I've got?

SO-Units, Tallis 911. Caller reports about eight fishermen and sightseers parked at the Riverside Park boat ramp, with kids climbing on the riprap. No emergency, no one in the water. The caller just doesn't like it.
Any unit available to swing by Riverside Park, boat ramp lot off River Road. Tallis 911, zero six forty-one.

fields.voiceStyle: PW-14: middle-aged male road crew lead, outdoors in a running pickup, matter-of-fact, a little impatient. Tallis 911: female dispatcher, steady, clipped professional radio cadence.

instructorNote: This is a resource problem: there are only 12 barricades, enough for River Road but not also for the Mill Street underpass. Watch for PW to close River Road before 15.0 ft and to get loaner barricades from the City of Cedar Ford so the underpass closes before 17.0 ft. Each closure should go to the EOC with the road, status, flood stage and time. Field should send a deputy to clear the riprap without force and confirm that Cedar Ford Fire swift water crews are ready. No crews should go onto a road that is flooding.
